what.text: This page follows people displaced inside Haiti by conflict and violence, counted by IDMC and by UNHCR and shown side by side.
At the end of 2025 both sources give the same figure, 1430903 people.
Refugees from Haiti live mainly in Brazil, France and Canada.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Haiti with Viv Ansanm in 2024 and 2025, at war level in 2025.
It records an earlier armed conflict over the government in 2004, with FLRN and OP Lavalas.
Storms are among the disasters recorded for Haiti in IDMC's data.

when.text: IDMC's figure rose from 2128 in 2019 to 1430903 in 2025.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2024 and 2025, the years of the conflict UCDP records.
New displacements from conflict were highest in 2025, and those from disasters in 2010, in IDMC's records.

how.text: UNHCR's and IDMC's figures overlap and are counted differently, so they are shown side by side and never added.
IDMC's new displacements count movements, not people: someone forced to move twice in a year is counted twice.
The sources don't say where inside Haiti people moved to.
